# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This file contains repository-wide instructions for GitHub Copilot coding agent.

## General Guidelines

- Follow best practices for the technologies used in this project
- Write clear, maintainable, and well-documented code
- Include appropriate error handling
- Add tests for new functionality when applicable
- Keep changes focused and minimal

## Code Style

- Use consistent formatting and naming conventions
- Write descriptive commit messages
- Follow existing code patterns in the repository

## Security

- Never commit secrets or sensitive information
- Follow security best practices
- Validate and sanitize inputs appropriately

## Git Workflow

- Only commit to branches prefixed with `copilot/`
- Create focused pull requests with clear descriptions
- All PRs require human review before merging
